card.name: Words opening an aside or example
card.fires_on: Dashes, parentheses and short linking words that open an aside, example or clarification in the middle of a sentence, such as "say", "or", "for" (instance) or "during". Seen in general web prose.

modes.label: Dash before an aside
modes.description: An em dash or a word right after it that introduces an example, elaboration or contrast.
modes.example: Bellows never traveled abroad, but learned the lessons of European masters<<—>>such as El Greco, Francisco de

modes.label: Linking word opening an insertion
modes.description: A short word or bracket that begins an inserted example or qualifier mid-sentence.
modes.example: It is still necessary and profitable,<< for>> instance, to read commentaries on books

card.writes: It pushes toward connectives that start a clause, such as when, because, since and whenever.
card.plain: It fires at the point where a sentence pauses for an aside or example, and it predicts that an explaining clause comes next.
